$comment: Locked launch parameters for SPLC at 1,000,000,000 (1B) total supply. Bootstrap-launch model: initial public liquidity is intentionally small ($1k pair-side on Arbitrum One). Market discovers price. Future presale rounds (Reg D / Reg CF) are priced from then-current market price, NOT from a pre-set target. No fabricated FDV. Read by deploy scripts. Edit BEFORE running any mainnet pool seed.

supply.comment: 1B SPLC total, minted once at construction. Bridged via LayerZero V2 OFT to additional chains — never re-minted per chain.

launchModel.rationale: Fair-launch bootstrap. Solo-founder project with $1k initial pair-side capital. Market discovers true valuation organically. No private valuation premium implied. No promised price appreciation. Reg D / Reg CF rounds (if conducted) will be priced from then-current 30-day VWAP at offering date, not a pre-set target.

tax.appliesTo: V2-style AMM pairs ONLY (PancakeSwap V2, SushiSwap V2, QuickSwap, Aerodrome, Velodrome). NEVER call setAmmPair on Uniswap V3 pools — breaks K-invariant.

tokenomics.$comment: 9-bucket allocation totalling 1B SPLC. Allocations are fixed; pricing of presale buckets is market-discovered at the time of each offering, not pre-set here.

treasuryOps.notes: Operations runway: legal, audits, marketing, dev payroll, future CEX listings

stakingRewards.notes: Perpetual rewards stream — 48mo linear release, governance-extendable

publicPresale.destination: SPLCPresalePublic (Reg CF + Reg S non-US, when/if conducted)
publicPresale.notes: Price set from then-current 30-day market VWAP at offering open. Not pre-committed.

accreditedRegD.destination: SPLCPresaleVesting (Reg D 506(c), per-investor schedules, when/if conducted)
accreditedRegD.notes: US accredited only. KYC via VerifyInvestor.com. Price set from then-current 30-day market VWAP at offering open. Not pre-committed.

lpSeed.notes: 1M deployed to Arbitrum bootstrap pool at launch. Remaining 14M reserved for cross-chain pool expansion via LayerZero OFT as capital allows.

cexListingReserve.destination: Cold storage Ledger (separate from operating wallets)
cexListingReserve.notes: Reserved for Tier-1 CEX listings. Use ONLY when listing agreement signed. Idle until then.

ecosystemGrants.notes: DAO-voted grants: integrations, hackathons, builder bounties

pools.$comment: Pool deploy plan. Bootstrap launch on Arbitrum One only, with single Uniswap V3 1% pool, full-range, 1M SPLC + ~$1k USDC. Tax-INACTIVE (V3 K-invariant). Cross-chain expansion via LayerZero OFT as capital and demand justify.

futureExpansion.$comment: Additional pools (ETH, Base, BSC, Polygon, Optimism + V2 tax-active pools) will be deployed when capital and organic demand justify. NOT pre-committed. NOT a promise to investors. Driven by reserve.lpSeed (14M SPLC remaining) and treasuryOps allocation.

lpLock.$comment: 1yr enforced by SPLCLPLock.sol. Recommendation: lock 2yr at launch for stronger trust signal. Always extendable, never shortenable.

ammTax.appliesOn: V2 pool swaps only (no V2 pool exists at bootstrap launch)

v3LpFees.destination: LP NFT holder via SPLCLPLock → treasury at unlock

feeRevenue.$legalNote: AMM tax 50/50 split prevents single-beneficiary Howey-test risk. Staking-vault share returns value to holders via on-chain governance. Bootstrap pool is V3 only — 3.14% tax does not fire until/unless a V2 pool is added with explicit setAmmPair() call.

founder.type: EOA (migrate to Ledger before any large vested withdrawal)

treasury.type: Safe multisig (3-of-5 recommended) — currently EOA, migrate before pool seed if possible
treasury.balance: 200M vested + AMM tax 50% share (when V2 pool added)

deployer.type: EOA (hot wallet, gas only — never custody)

cexColdStorage.address: TBD — generate fresh Ledger before any CEX listing

complianceRequirements.geoBlock: Client-side US-block + accredited affirmation gate live on all financial pages
complianceRequirements.kycVerification: REQUIRED for US accredited investors via VerifyInvestor.com or Parallel Markets, when/if Reg D round is conducted
complianceRequirements.audit: RECOMMENDED before any large pool expansion or CEX listing (Hacken / Cyfrin / CertiK budget $20-60k). Contract has 121-test Hardhat suite passing; bootstrap launch acceptable on test coverage alone.
complianceRequirements.multisig: RECOMMENDED — transfer SPLC proxy ownership + treasury to Safe multisig before pool seeding (or as soon as practical post-bootstrap)
complianceRequirements.vestingTransparency: All vest schedules published on-chain, queryable via SPLCPresaleVesting.schedules(address)
complianceRequirements.disclaimer: Trading involves risk. Past performance does not guarantee future results.
complianceRequirements.noPromisedReturns: NO marketing material, page copy, or social post may promise specific price targets, FDV growth, or guaranteed returns. Bootstrap = market-discovered. Period.
